latest_data: ASCO 2025 (abstract 2500): LBL-024 + etoposide/platinum in treatment-naive advanced extrapulmonary NEC, ORR 75% (n=52), 83.3% ORR and 100% DCR at the 15 mg/kg dose. notes: Highest phase recorded as phase 2 because the registrational EP-NEC study is a single-arm pivotal Phase 2; no out-licensing found (rights assumed retained). NDA status not verified.

latest_data: Phase 3 G-HOPE-001 (NCT06238843; n=464, China/Japan; previously treated CLDN18.2+ HER2- G/GEJ adenocarcinoma, monotherapy vs investigator's choice) met its primary endpoint at the first interim analysis (2025) and the NDA was accepted by NMPA for later-line CLDN18.2+ gastric cancer. ASCO 2025 oral: Phase 1 in CLDN18.2+ advanced pancreatic cancer showed durable efficacy with matured PFS/OS; Phase 3 in 1L pancreatic cancer planned in China. first_in_class_note: Among the first CLDN18.2 ADCs to reach registrational stage; FDA Fast Track (pancreatic cancer).
notes: Described by Fierce Biotech as 'Takeda-partnered' following the Oct 2025 Innovent-Takeda collaboration (Takeda holds an option/partnership on ex-China rights); exact territory terms not verified. Approval status after NDA acceptance not verified.

latest_data: NMPA approved 1L cervical cancer (all-comers, with platinum chemo +/- bevacizumab) in June 2025 based on Phase 3 COMPASSION-16 (PFS and OS met, benefit also in PD-L1 CPS<1), the third China indication after 2L cervical (2022) and 1L gastric (2024). Dec 2025: FDA cleared global Phase 3 COMPASSION-37 (1L gastric, vs chemo +/- nivolumab); Aug 2025: NMPA/FDA cleared global registrational COMPASSION-36 (cadonilimab + lenvatinib in PD-1-resistant HCC).
first_in_class_note: First-in-class PD-1/CTLA-4 bispecific and the first approved dual immune checkpoint bispecific antibody (China, June 2022).
notes: 'cardonilizumab' appears to be a variant spelling of cadonilimab (AK104). In this trial combined with LM-302 (a Claudin18.2 ADC from LaNova Medicines). || Also filed under dev code AK104 (see separate row, same molecule). || Development code for cadonilimab (see separate row); same molecule, duplicate entry in dataset. || asset_key 'candonilimab' is a misspelling of cadonilimab (AK104) used in investigator-initiated trial records. Global rights retained by Akeso.

latest_data: Global Phase 3 FURVENT (1L EGFR exon 20 insertion NSCLC, firmonertinib vs chemo; run jointly with Allist) completed enrollment in Q1 2025 with topline monotherapy data guided for mid-2026 (ArriVent 8-K, Mar 2026); FDA Breakthrough Therapy Designation for 1L ex20ins NSCLC; global Phase 3 ALPACCA in 1L EGFR PACC-mutant NSCLC has dosed first patient. Approved in China (Ivesa) for EGFR T790M+ NSCLC (2021) and 1L EGFR-mutant NSCLC (2022).
first_in_class_note: Positioned as potential first oral TKI for 1L EGFR exon 20 insertion NSCLC (FDA BTD, Orphan Drug).
notes: 'Firmonertinib' is the spelling used in this input; the approved drug is furmonertinib (Allist Pharmaceuticals, Shanghai; brand Alflutinib), a third-generation EGFR TKI approved in China (and later the US, as Bripiza, for EGFR exon 20 insertion NSCLC). || AST2818 is Allist's original development code. || Approved China 2021 (Alflutinib) and US Nov 2024 (Bayanni) for EGFR exon20ins NSCLC; pursued largely without a big-pharma ex-China license, to my recollection. || Brand name Yifubei (艾氟替尼); approved in China (2021) for EGFR-mutant NSCLC, later expanded to first-line use. || Ex-China rights licensed to ArriVent BioPharma (US) in 2021; trials in this batch include investigator-initiated China studies (e.g., combination with ABSK043). || Furmonertinib (Alflutinib) approved in China (2021) for EGFR-mutant NSCLC; developed by Shanghai Allist Pharmaceuticals. || NMPA approved 2021 (T790M+ 2L) and 2022 (1L EGFR-mutant NSCLC); China exon20ins registration status not verified. Some CT.gov trials in this batch are ArriVent-sponsored global studies (firmonertinib spelling). || This is a radiolabeled ([14C]) mass-balance/ADME study of Allist's approved EGFR TKI, conducted in Chinese healthy volunteers (china_title_hits=1 confirms). || highest_phase reflects overall program status (already approved in China for standard EGFR mutations); this specific record is a global Phase 3 for the PACC/L861Q subset.

latest_data: ASH 2024: Phase 1 of EMB-06 in R/R multiple myeloma showed clinical activity with minimal cytokine release. ACR 2025 abstract described preclinical-to-clinical translation for autoimmune disease; Candid reports >100 patients treated across myeloma and autoimmune indications with studies in >10 autoimmune indications (2025-2026), positioning cizutamig as potential best-in-class BCMA TCE for autoimmunity.
first_in_class_note: Positioned as potential best-in-class BCMA T-cell engager for autoimmune diseases.
notes: EpimAb (Shanghai/Suzhou) BCMAxCD3 bispecific for multiple myeloma; trial terminated. || Originated by EpimAb (Shanghai) as EMB-06; global autoimmune rights held by Candid Therapeutics (San Diego; formed Sept 2024 by acquiring Vignette Bio, which had licensed EMB-06). The autoimmune trials in this batch are sponsored by Candid (US), so classify as non-CN if the pipeline keys on current sponsor rather than originator.

latest_data: Approved by NMPA Dec 2020 (R/R CLL/SLL, R/R MCL) and 2023 (R/R MZL). Phase 2 in relapsing MS met its primary endpoint (2023) though Biogen returned rights; phase 3 in ITP (China) reported positive results with an NDA submitted (2024-2025, from recollection). Batch trials are the 2017-2020 phase 1-2 studies under the ICP-022 code.
notes: Open Targets: 4 approved indications, trade name Innobruka. Biogen license (USD 125M upfront, 2021) was terminated in 2023 so ex-China rights reverted to InnoCare. Web verification unavailable in this session (WebSearch budget exhausted, WebFetch/curl egress-blocked); classification based on local ClinicalTrials.gov/Open Targets records plus prior knowledge (cutoff mid-2026). || Seed maps the generic 'btki' (BTK inhibitor) label to InnoCare's orelabrutinib (approved in China for MCL/CLL), but the linked trial (NCT04978779) sample title actually describes VIP152 (enitociclib), a CDK9 inhibitor of Bayer/Vincerx Pharma origin, unrelated to BTK -- likely a data-linkage mismatch in the source aggregation. notes: Broad HER2 ADC program across breast/gastric/other solid tumors. I recall Hengrui pursuing ex-China licensing for parts of its ADC pipeline around this period but do not have confident recall of a specific finalized partner for this exact asset, so left blank rather than guess. || Input data already confirms INN (trastuzumab rezetecan) and stage (approval). Medium confidence on the exact out-licensing newco name/terms - flagging for verification. || SHR-A1811 is Hengrui's HER2-targeting ADC with a topoisomerase-I-inhibitor payload, approved in China for HER2+ breast cancer. || Seed sponsor guess 'Shanghai Henlius Biotech' appears incorrect. The INN and the trial's combination partner 'retlirafusp alfa' (Hengrui's PD-L1/TGF-beta bifunctional fusion protein SHR-1701) both point to Jiangsu Hengrui Pharmaceuticals as sponsor/originator, not Henlius. Confidence is medium since this is a prior-knowledge cross-reference, not verified live.

notes: Andrographolide is a traditional Chinese/herbal compound (Andrographis paniculata). This trial (NCT01993472) looks investigator/academic-sponsored (likely a Chinese hospital), distinct from HUTCHMED's related but separate HMPL-004 Andrographis extract program for ulcerative colitis. Medium confidence on CN attribution given generic/academic nature; seed 'HUTCHMED' plausible as loosely-related but likely not the direct trial sponsor. || HUTCHMED is Hong Kong/China-founded with primary R&D based in Shanghai, though also listed on Nasdaq/LSE/HKEX; classified CN. Recall the Crohn's disease Phase 3 program did not meet its endpoint and was largely deprioritized. || HUTCHMED's HMPL-004 is an Andrographis paniculata-derived botanical drug historically studied for ulcerative colitis and respiratory infections. Andrographolide is also a widely-studied generic natural-product ingredient used by other groups (e.g., academic MS and COVID-19 trials), so not every trial in this cluster is necessarily HUTCHMED-sponsored. || Not confident this reached approval anywhere despite ot_max_stage=APPROVAL in input; leaving as investigational per best recall.

US/EU/Japan) rights.
